subject: Re: Mid-cycle usage/seat rebalance & adjusted invoice pathing
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cerebratech.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@cerebratech.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:24:00 +0100
Subject: Mid-cycle seat rebalance — invoice and VAT clarification

Hi Neha,

Quick one — we adjusted our committed seats and enabled a short burst of dedicated capacity on 2026-05-07 when a model retrain spiked usage. Our finance team was expecting a prorated invoice and a credit for the portion of the month we reduced seats (we dropped 12 seats to 8 on 2026-05-12).

Sofia asked whether the credit will show as a line item on the May invoice or as a separate interim document. Also need confirmation on VAT treatment: CerebraTech is an Ireland-registered entity (VAT IE1234567) — do you apply reverse-charge or charge VAT on the prorated credit+usage? Lastly, we attached the PO for this quarter.

Attachments: PO_4732.pdf (PDF)

Can you confirm path to payment and an ETA for the adjusted invoice? We need the final figure to release a SEPA payment.

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of Platform Operations
CerebraTech
oliver@cerebratech.com
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cerebratech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat rebalance — invoice and VAT clarification

Hi Oliver — thanks for the details and the PO. Quick acknowledgement while we pull the numbers.

Action items I’m kicking off:
- Kimberly (billing) will produce an adjusted invoice with the prorated credit and the burst usage line items.
- Marcus (finance) will confirm VAT treatment for an Ireland entity and finalise the payment instructions for SEPA.
- I will confirm whether the credit appears on the May consolidated invoice or as a short interim invoice.

Kimberly/Marcus: please see the usage breakout attached by Oliver (below). If possible, can we produce an invoice PDF and send it to CerebraTech today so they can schedule SEPA?

Neha
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cerebratech.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@cerebratech.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:47:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat rebalance — invoice and VAT clarification

Thanks Neha. Attaching the usage breakout per your request.

Summary for your convenience:
- Committed seats: increased to 20 on 2026-05-01 (monthly commit)
- Short-term burst: +6 GPUs 2026-05-07 02:00 UTC through 2026-05-08 18:00 UTC
- Seat reduction: reduced committed seats from 20 to 8 on 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC
- Expected: prorated credit for days 12-31 for 12 seats; burst billed as usage add-on pro-rated to the hours used.

Attachments: usage_breakout_May2026.csv (CSV), PO_4732.pdf (PDF)

Oliver
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cerebratech.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:28:00 +0100
Subject: Adjusted invoice & VAT handling for CerebraTech (DL-78904)

Hi Oliver / Sofia,

Thank you for sending the breakout. I ran the numbers against usage logs and the committed-seat schedule. Summary below (numbers rounded to 2 decimals):

- Prorated credit for seat reduction (12 seats, 20 -> 8 between 2026-05-12 through 2026-05-31): €5,184.00 credit (applied as a negative line item).
- Burst usage (6 GPUs x ~40 hours total): €1,140.00 (usage add-on).
- Base monthly commit (May pro-rated for remaining seats/days): €9,760.00
- Net amount before VAT: €5,716.00 (this is base + usage - credit).

VAT / tax handling: because CerebraTech provided an Ireland VAT registration (IE1234567) and the billing entity in Redwood's contract is Redwood EU Services Ltd (Ireland), we will apply reverse-charge on the net amount — no Irish VAT charged. Marcus, please confirm the reverse-charge note text included on the invoice.

Invoice pathing: we created an adjusted invoice PDF which includes the credit line and a comment referencing PO_4732. I have attached it for payment.

Attachments: adjusted_invoice_CEREBRATECH_20260519.pdf (PDF)

Payment instructions: SEPA (preferred). Marcus will share the beneficiary and reference string (please include DL-78904 in payment reference). If you prefer card, let us know and we can process faster but there will be a card fee.

Can you confirm acceptance and whether you want the credit applied as a separate credit note or shown on the invoice? If you accept the invoice as-is we will mark it final and release the invoice link to your finance portal.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cerebratech.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Adjusted invoice & VAT handling for CerebraTech (DL-78904)

Kimberly / team — thanks, that works for us.

We confirm:
- Accept adjusted_invoice_CEREBRATECH_20260519.pdf as final.
- SEPA payment will be initiated today; reference will include DL-78904.
- Please include the reverse-charge VAT note on the invoice copy we store for audit.

Oliver
Head of Platform Operations
CerebraTech
